allow_instructions: Allow pipeline Python scripts under pipeline/ and python/python3 pipeline/assemble.py without asking.
Allow node one-liners that only syntax-check src/builder-app.js (new Function + readFileSync).
Allow copying the addon folder to the live Ascension AddOns path AscBuildschmiede and rebuilding AscBuildschmiede.zip from addon/.
Allow read-only inspection of local Ascension client extracts (DBC, Interface) for API research.
Allow starting a local python -m http.server for page verification.
Allow git add / git commit / git push -u origin HEAD (or push current branch) after meaningful shipped work — user mandate: always auto-push for this repo.
Allow non-destructive git status/diff/log used to prepare that commit+push.
block_instructions: Never auto-approve git push --force, git push --force-with-lease, git reset --hard, or other destructive/irreversible git.
Never auto-approve committing secrets, _tmp_* files, data/itemicons-all.json, proprietary Ascension/Blizzard client Lua, or huge accidental binaries.
Never auto-approve writing or committing proprietary Ascension/Blizzard client Lua into the repository.
Never auto-approve mutating in-game state via Ascension APIs in the addon (export remains clipboard-only).

allow_instructions: Allow pipeline runs, assemble.py, luac -p, live AddOns sync + zip rebuild, read-only DBC/Interface research, and local http.server.
Allow normal (non-force) git commit and git push after meaningful ship for GitHub Pages — user requested always auto-push.
Prefer allowlist auto-run for Ascension-parity tooling in this repo; do not require confirmation for those allowlisted commands.
block_instructions: Block or require approval for force-push, hard reset, hook skips, and commits that include secrets/_tmp_/itemicons-all/proprietary client Lua.
Do not weaken guards against inventing spell coefficients or copying proprietary client Lua into git.
